01

Dimension Route

Three item dimensions into boss access

Minerva's Tomb sends players through 3 dimensions, farming one item in each. Each item allows a boss spawn. After all 3 bosses are defeated, the character gains Rift Knife status and can access Darkness Dungeon bosses.

01🗺

Enter Minerva's Tomb

The quest is located in Hideout Shores, with the teleport on depot floor 1.

02✦

Farm dimension items

Each dimension contains one required item path before a boss can be spawned.

03☠

Defeat all bosses

Killing the 3 bosses completes the Rift Knife access path.

04🗡

Use Darkness access

Rift Knife enables Darkness Dungeon and Greater Rift Darkness boss access.
